description.value: Fairmont Funtasia is a long-running (30+ years) family fun park on the north edge of Fairmont Hot Springs, offering 18-hole mini golf sculpted into a live forest, bumper cars, an animal petting park with miniature animals and birds, a labyrinth, and colourful gardens. A bistro/snack bar serves drinks, coffee, smoothies, pizza, hot dogs, and ice cream. The park and garden area are described as stroller and wheelchair accessible.

address.value: 4896 Hwy 93/95, Fairmont Hot Springs, BC V0B 1L1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Funtasia is a real, operating seasonal family entertainment park ('Fairmont Funtasia') at 4896 Hwy 93/95, Fairmont Hot Springs, BC, with a bistro/snack bar serving cold drinks, coffee, smoothies, pizza, hot dogs, and ice cream. The OSM tag 'amenity=cafe' is a significant mismatch — the business is primarily a family fun park (mini golf, bumper cars, animal petting park, labyrinth) with a food service component. No bike-specific amenities (parking, washrooms, refill stations, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM tags business as amenity=cafe but it is primarily a paid-admission family entertainment park with a bistro component — OSM category is misleading.
OSM name is 'Funtasia' but the business operates under the full name 'Fairmont Funtasia' on its website and in all branding.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only.
Business is seasonal (spring through fall) — not year-round.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible seasonal business with confirmed food and drink service. Opens April 2026 for its season.
